snippet.title: Early Access Trailer ⭐🎮
snippet.description:
Excited to announce that Starforge Pirate will release into Early Access on December 3rd, 2026! Here's a trailer showing some of the current gameplay.

Link to the game's Discord server, where you can still play-test an early version of the game! https://discord.gg/J3apRuPdWp

Link to wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4802240/Starforge_Pirate/ 

⭐🎮 

Music Credit : Pemberton, Daniel. “Across the Spider-Verse (Start a Band).” Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (Original Score), Sony Classical, 2023.
